title: Big Globe x L_Ender's Cataclysm
description: Compatibility Datapack between Big Globe and L_Ender's Cataclysm.
body:
This datapack allows L_Ender's Cataclysm structures to spawn in Big Globe worlds.

The structures are generated taking advantage of big globe's overriders to place the structures in proper locations and smoothen the terrain around them.

In case of issues, find me on Big Globe's discord server.
